issues.description: The problem statement requires Bookstore to be initializable with an array of Book using the initializer signature init(books: [Book]). In the solution, Bookstore's initializer is declared as init(books: Set<Book>) while the stored property is declared as let books: [Book]. The solution's Client constructs an array [Book] and calls Bookstore(books: books), which is incompatible with the solution Bookstore initializer. This mismatch prevents the provided solution from compiling and contradicts the constructor signature specified in the problem statement.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution conform to the problem specification by changing the Bookstore initializer to accept an array: init(books: [Book]) { self.books = books }. Alternatively (less preferred since the spec expects an array), adjust the stored property to be a Set<Book> and update Client to pass a Set and ensure Book conforms to Hashable. The simplest fix that preserves the exercise intent is to use init(books: [Book]).
